name: GitHub MCP Server
description: Official GitHub MCP server maintained by GitHub. Exposes the GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs as tools — creating issues and PRs, searching repositories, reading files, managing branches, and more.

doc_quality.notes: Well-structured README with installation instructions, tool catalog, and configuration options. Docker and npx install paths both documented. Tool parameter descriptions could be more detailed for complex operations.

auth_security.notes: Uses GitHub Personal Access Tokens with explicit scope requirements documented per tool. Token passed via environment variable. Read-only vs read-write scopes clearly separated. GitHub's own security team maintains the server.

tool_coverage.notes: 40+ tools covering repositories, issues, pull requests, file operations, branches, commits, search, and notifications. Broad coverage rivals the GitHub CLI. Toolset is continuously expanded with new GitHub features.

reliability.notes: Error handling mirrors GitHub API error semantics. Rate-limit errors surfaced cleanly. Dependent on GitHub API uptime; documentation acknowledges this. Pagination handled automatically.

community.notes: First-party GitHub server with thousands of GitHub stars. Active issue tracker. Funded and maintained by a 100-person company. Bug fixes typically shipped within days of report.
